title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 18, Iran's new Minister of Defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made remarks at the Parliamnet.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN - Oct 18, Iran's new Minister of Defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made remarks at the Parliamnet."

"-------"

"SOT1, Mehrdad Akhlaghi, Iran's Minister of Defense (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:25): "We have taken the necessary measures for this matter [referring to MBOMB of the U.S , Mother of all bombs] , and we are at ease; we are performing our job comfortably. [Trump] He should be preoccupied with thinking about how to get his people out of our region safely. If he drops a single bomb, he will have to come and see how many of his people he has to pick up horizontally. Rest assured, this is exactly what has prevented him from attacking so far; he has only issued slogans. If his slogans turn into action, then he will see the result."

""
"SOT2, Mehrdad Akhlaghi, Iran's Minister of Defense (Farsi) (00:26 - 00:37): "Rest assured that it is highly unlikely they will dare to attack us; if they do, there will be massive damage to both themselves and the region.
